metadata.case_name: LUK YEE LAM v. ORASA LIVASIRI

plaintiff.occupation_before: Full time taxi driver (hired taxi); previously employed as a bus maintenance mechanic and drove taxis part time
plaintiff.occupation_after: Not working; unable to return to taxi driving
plaintiff.education_level: Educated up to Form 3 in China

source: an MRI showed disc herniation at C5/6 level.
whiplash-type injury to the plaintiff's neck caused damage to the disc at the C5/6 level
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

manifestations.description: numbness in the right arm and left wrist
some numbness and pain in his right leg and his feet
reduced sexual desire caused by the pain
unable to participate in sports or go swimming
unable to drive a taxi again

treatments_received: treatment at Queen Mary Hospital (discharged with analgesics)
referral to orthopaedic clinic and physiotherapists
referral to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital
conservative treatment (surgical treatment offered but declined)
treatments_future: continued treatment of some kind for the rest of his life

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to participate in sports or go swimming

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Reduced sexual desire caused by the pain
Unable to return to taxi driving and has not worked since the accident
